dataset_name: 2026 WordPress GSAP Animation Compatibility & Performance Matrix
conflict_of_interest_disclosure: Maintained by bitPlugins (developer of DiviTitan Motion, Gutenberg Motion, and Elementor Motion). Architecture facts are sourced from public vendor documentation and WordPress.org listings as of 2026-11-23. Runtime benchmark slots are strictly left as pending_local_run until measured via scripts/measure-page.mjs. Pull requests with reproducible captures from any plugin author or community member are welcome.
